description: This Java class 'InventoryWorker' provides utility methods for managing and querying inventory and order data, including fetching outstanding purchase orders, calculating net outstanding quantities, and retrieving product quantities across orders.

classes.name: InventoryWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for inventory and order data processing.

methods.name: getOutstandingPurchaseOrders
methods.description: Retrieves all outstanding purchase orders for a given productId, excluding completed, canceled, or rejected orders.

methods.name: getOutstandingPurchasedQuantity
methods.description: Calculates the net outstanding quantity of a product by summing quantities from outstanding purchase orders, accounting for cancellations.

methods.name: getOutstandingProductQuantities
methods.description: Returns a map of product IDs to their outstanding quantities for a specified order type (sales or purchase).

methods.name: getOutstandingProductQuantitiesForSalesOrders
methods.description: Wrapper for getting outstanding product quantities specifically for sales orders.

methods.name: getOutstandingProductQuantitiesForPurchaseOrders
methods.description: Wrapper for getting outstanding product quantities specifically for purchase orders.
